citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 7.4 "Unknown or unforeseen message type"

text:
[7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.5 Non-semantical mandatory information element errors > 7.5.1 Common procedures]
When on receipt of a message,

-	an "imperative message part" error; or

-	a "missing mandatory IE" error

is diagnosed or when a message containing:

-	a syntactically incorrect mandatory IE;

-	an IE unknown in the message, but encoded as "comprehension required" (see 3GPP TS 24.007 [12]); or

-	an out of sequence IE encoded as "comprehension required" (see 3GPP TS 24.007 [12]) is received,

the UE shall proceed as follows:

If the message is not one of the messages listed in clause 7.5.3, item a, b, c, or d, the UE shall return a status message (EMM STATUS or ESM STATUS depending on the PD) with cause #96 "invalid mandatory information"; and

the network shall proceed as follows:

If the message is not one of the messages listed in clause 7.5.3, item e, f, g or h, the network shall either:

-	try to treat the message (the exact further actions are implementation dependent); or

-	ignore the message except that it should return a status message (EMM STATUS or ESM STATUS depending on the PD) with cause #96 "invalid mandatory information".
heading_path: 7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.5 Non-semantical mandatory information element errors > 7.5.1 Common procedures
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 7.5.1 "Common procedures"

text:
[7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.5 Non-semantical mandatory information element errors > 7.5.2 EPS mobility management]
No exceptional cases are described for mobility management messages.

No semantical or syntactical diagnosis other than presence and length shall be performed on the ESM message container information element in the ATTACH REQUEST, ATTACH ACCEPT, ATTACH COMPLETE and CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST messages.
heading_path: 7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.5 Non-semantical mandatory information element errors > 7.5.2 EPS mobility management
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 7.5.2 "EPS mobility management"

text:
[7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.5 Non-semantical mandatory information element errors > 7.5.3 EPS session management]
The following UE procedures shall apply for handling an error encountered with a mandatory information element in an ESM message:

a)	If the message is an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST, an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message with ESM cause #96 "invalid mandatory information", shall be returned.

b)	If the message is an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST, an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message with ESM cause #96 "invalid mandatory information", shall be returned.

c)	If the message is a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST, a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message with ESM cause #96 "invalid mandatory information", shall be returned.

d)	If the message is a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST, a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message shall be returned. All resources associated with that EPS bearer shall be released.

The following network procedures shall apply for handling an error encountered with a mandatory information element in an ESM message:

e)	If the message is a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST, a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message with ESM cause #96 "invalid mandatory information", shall be returned.

f)	If the message is a PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST, a PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message with ESM cause #96 "invalid mandatory information", shall be returned.
heading_path: 7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.5 Non-semantical mandatory information element errors > 7.5.3 EPS session management
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 7.5.3 "EPS session management"

text:
[7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.5 Non-semantical mandatory information element errors > 7.5.3 EPS session management]
g)	If the message is a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST, a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message with ESM cause #96 "invalid mandatory information", shall be returned.

h)	If the message is a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST, a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message with ESM cause #96 "invalid mandatory information", shall be returned.
heading_path: 7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.5 Non-semantical mandatory information element errors > 7.5.3 EPS session management
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 7.5.3 "EPS session management"

text:
[7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.6 Unknown and unforeseen IEs in the non-imperative message part > 7.6.1 IEIs unknown in the message]
The UE shall ignore all IEs unknown in a message which are not encoded as "comprehension required" (see 3GPP TS 24.007 [12]).

The network shall take the same approach.
heading_path: 7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.6 Unknown and unforeseen IEs in the non-imperative message part > 7.6.1 IEIs unknown in the message
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 7.6.1 "IEIs unknown in the message"

text:
[7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.6 Unknown and unforeseen IEs in the non-imperative message part > 7.6.2 Out of sequence IEs]
The UE shall ignore all out of sequence IEs in a message which are not encoded as "comprehension required" (see 3GPP TS 24.007 [12]).

The network should take the same approach.
heading_path: 7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.6 Unknown and unforeseen IEs in the non-imperative message part > 7.6.2 Out of sequence IEs
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 7.6.2 "Out of sequence IEs"

text:
[7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.6 Unknown and unforeseen IEs in the non-imperative message part > 7.6.3 Repeated IEs]
If an information element with format T, TV, TLV, or TLV-E is repeated in a message in which repetition of the information element is not specified in clause 8 of the present document, the UE shall handle only the contents of the information element appearing first and shall ignore all subsequent repetitions of the information element. When repetition of information elements is specified, the UE shall handle only the contents of specified repeated information elements. If the limit on repetition of information elements is exceeded, the UE shall handle the contents of information elements appearing first up to the limit of repetitions and shall ignore all subsequent repetitions of the information element.

The network should follow the same procedures.

citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 7.6.3 "Repeated IEs"

text:
[7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.7 Non-imperative message part errors]
This category includes:

-	syntactically incorrect optional IEs; and

-	conditional IE errors.

citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 7.7 "Non-imperative message part errors"

text:
[7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.7 Non-imperative message part errors > 7.7.1 Syntactically incorrect optional IEs]
The UE shall treat all optional IEs that are syntactically incorrect in a message as not present in the message.

The network shall take the same approach.
heading_path: 7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.7 Non-imperative message part errors > 7.7.1 Syntactically incorrect optional IEs
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 7.7.1 "Syntactically incorrect optional IEs"

text:
[7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.7 Non-imperative message part errors > 7.7.2 Conditional IE errors]
When upon receipt of a EMM or ESM message the UE diagnoses a "missing conditional IE" error or an "unexpected conditional IE" error, or when it receives a EMM or ESM message containing at least one syntactically incorrect conditional IE, the UE shall ignore the message and shall return a status message (EMM STATUS or ESM STATUS depending on the PD) with cause #100 "conditional IE error".

When the network receives a message and diagnoses a "missing conditional IE" error or an "unexpected conditional IE" error or when it receives a message containing at least one syntactically incorrect conditional IE, the network shall either:

-	try to treat the message (the exact further actions are implementation dependent); or

-	ignore the message except that it should return a status message (EMM STATUS or ESM STATUS depending on the PD) with cause #100 "conditional IE error".
heading_path: 7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.7 Non-imperative message part errors > 7.7.2 Conditional IE errors
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 7.7.2 "Conditional IE errors"

text:
[7 Handling of unknown, unforeseen, and erroneous protocol data > 7.8 Messages with semantically incorrect contents]
When a message with semantically incorrect contents is received, the UE shall perform the foreseen reactions of the procedural part of the present document (i.e. of clauses 4, 5 and 6). If however no such reactions are specified, the UE shall ignore the message except that it shall return a status message (EMM STATUS or ESM STATUS depending on the PD) with cause #95 "semantically incorrect message".

The network should follow the same procedure except that a status message is not normally transmitted.

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.1 Overview]
This clause defines the structure of the messages of the Layer 3 (L3) protocols defined in the present document. These are standard L3 messages as defined in 3GPP TS 24.007 [12].

Each definition given in the present clause includes:

a)	a brief description of the message direction and use, including whether the message has:

1.	Local significance, i.e. relevant only on the originating or terminating access;

2.	Access significance, i.e. relevant in the originating and terminating access, but not in the network;

3.	Dual significance, i.e. relevant in either the originating or terminating access and in the network; or

4.	Global significance, i.e. relevant in the originating and terminating access and in the network.

b)	a table listing the Information Elements (IE) known in the message and the order of their appearance in the message. All IEs that may be repeated are explicitly indicated (The V, LV and LV-E formatted IEs, which compose the imperative part of the message, occur before the T, TV, TLV and TLV-E formatted IEs which compose the non-imperative part of the message, see 3GPP TS 24.007 [12]). In a (maximal) sequence of consecutive IEs with half octet length, the first IE with half octet length occupies bits 1 to 4 of octet N, the second IE bits 5 to 8 of octet N, the third IE bits 1 to 4 of octet N+1 etc. Such a sequence always has an even number of elements.

For each information element the table indicates:
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.1 Overview
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.1 "Overview"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.1 Overview]
1.	The Information Element Identifier (IEI), in hexadecimal notation, if the IE has format T, TV, TLV or TLV-E. If the IEI has half octet length, it is specified by a notation representing the IEI as a hexadecimal digit followed by a "-" (example: B-).

NOTE:	The same IEI can be used for different information element types in different messages of the same protocol.

2.	The name of the information element (which may give an idea of the semantics of the element). The name of the information element followed by "IE" or "information element" is used in this technical report as reference to the information element within a message.

3.	The name of the type of the information element (which indicates the coding of the value part of the IE), and generally, the referenced clause of clause 9 of the present document describing the value part of the information element.

4.	The presence requirement indication (M, C, or O) for the IE as defined in 3GPP TS 24.007 [12].

5.	The format of the information element (T, V, TV, LV, TLV, LV-E or TLV-E) as defined in 3GPP TS 24.007 [12].

6.	The length of the information element (or permissible range of lengths), in octets, in the message, where "?" means that the maximum length of the IE is only constrained by link layer protocol. This indication is non-normative.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.1 Overview
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.1 "Overview"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.1 Overview]
c)	clauses specifying, where appropriate, conditions for IEs with presence requirement C or O in the relevant message which together with other conditions specified in the present document define when the information elements shall be included or not, what non-presence of such IEs means, and – for IEs with presence requirement C – the static conditions for presence or non-presence of the IEs or for both cases (see 3GPP TS 24.007 [12]).

heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.5 EMM cause
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.5 "EMM cause"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.6 T3402 value]
This IE may be included to indicate a value for timer T3402.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.6 T3402 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.6 "T3402 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.7 T3423 value]
This IE may be included to indicate a value for timer T3423.

If this IE is not included, the UE shall use the default value.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.7 T3423 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.7 "T3423 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.8 Equivalent PLMNs]
This IE may be included in order to assign a new equivalent PLMNs list to a UE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.8 Equivalent PLMNs
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.8 "Equivalent PLMNs"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.9 Emergency number list]
This IE may be sent by the network. If this IE is sent, the contents of this IE indicates a list of emergency numbers valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.9 Emergency number list
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.9 "Emergency number list"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.9A Extended emergency number list]
This IE may be sent by the network. If this IE is sent, the contents of this IE indicates a list of emergency numbers (with URN information) valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received or valid only in the PLMN from which this IE is received.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.9A Extended emergency number list
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.9A "Extended emergency number list"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.10 EPS network feature support]
The network may include this IE to inform the UE of the support of certain features. If this IE is not included then the UE shall interpret this as a receipt of an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero, except for the S1-u data transfer (S1-U data) (octet 4, bit 2).

NOTE: In this exceptional case, the UE deems that the network supports S1-u data transfer.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.10 EPS network feature support
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.10 "EPS network feature support"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.11 Additional update result]
The network may include this IE to provide the UE with additional information about the result of:

-	a combined attach procedure if the procedure was successful for EPS services and non-EPS services, or for EPS services and "SMS only"; or

-	an attach procedure requested for CIoT EPS optimizations if the procedure was successful for EPS services and "SMS only".
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.11 Additional update result
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.11 "Additional update result"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.12 T3412 extended value]
The network may include this IE to provide the UE with longer periodic tracking area update timer.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.12 T3412 extended value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.12 "T3412 extended value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.13 T3324 value]
The network shall include the T3324 value IE if:

-	the UE included the T3324 value IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message; and

-	the network supports PSM and accepts the use of PSM.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.13 T3324 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.13 "T3324 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.14 Extended DRX parameters]
The network shall include the Extended DRX parameters IE if:

-	the UE included the Extended DRX parameters IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message; and

-	the network supports eDRX and accepts the use of eDRX.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.14 Extended DRX parameters
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.14 "Extended DRX parameters"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.15 DCN-ID]
This IE is included in the message when the network wishes to provide a DCN-ID to the UE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.15 DCN-ID
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.15 "DCN-ID"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.16 SMS services status]
This IE may be included when a normal attach procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" was successful for EPS services only.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.16 SMS services status
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.16 "SMS services status"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.17 Non-3GPP NW provided policies]
This IE is included if the network needs to indicate whether emergency numbers provided via non-3GPP access can be used to initiate UE detected emergency calls (see 3GPP TS 24.302 [48]). If this IE is not included then the UE shall interpret this as a receipt of an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.17 Non-3GPP NW provided policies
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.17 "Non-3GPP NW provided policies"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.18 T3448 value]
The network may include this IE if the congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane is active and the UE supports timer T3448.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.18 T3448 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.18 "T3448 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.19 Network policy]
This IE is included if the network needs to indicate network policy information to the UE, If this IE is not included then the UE shall interpret this as a receipt of an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.19 Network policy
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.19 "Network policy"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.20 T3447 value]
The network may include T3447 value IE if:

-	the UE has indicated support for service gap control in the ATTACH REQUEST message; and

-	the EMM context contains a service gap time value.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.20 T3447 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.20 "T3447 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.21 Ciphering key data]
This IE is included if the network needs to send ciphering key data to the UE for ciphered broadcast assistance data.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.21 Ciphering key data
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.21 "Ciphering key data"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.22 UE radio capability ID]
This IE may be included in WB-S1 mode if both the UE and the network supports RACS and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.22 UE radio capability ID
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.22 "UE radio capability ID"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.23 UE radio capability ID deletion indication]
This IE may be included in WB-S1 mode if both the UE and the network supports RACS and the network needs to trigger the UE to delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN.
section_title: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.23 UE radio capability ID deletion indication
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.23 "UE radio capability ID deletion indication"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.24 Negotiated WUS assistance information]
The network shall include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE if:

-	the UE supports WUS assistance;

-	the MME supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance; and

-	the UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.24 Negotiated WUS assistance information
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.24 "Negotiated WUS assistance information"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.25 Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode]
The network shall include the Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE if the UE has included the DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message.
section_title: Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.25 Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.25 "Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.26 Negotiated IMSI offset]
The network shall include the Negotiated IMSI offset IE if the network supports paging timing collision control and the MUSIM UE has included the Requested IMSI offset IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.26 Negotiated IMSI offset
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.26 "Negotiated IMSI offset"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.27 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"]
This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.
section_title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.27 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.1.27 "Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming""

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.28 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"]
This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.

heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.1 Attach accept > 8.2.1.28 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"

[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.4 Attach request > 8.2.4.2 Old P-TMSI signature]
The UE shall include this IE if the UE holds a valid P-TMSI signature, P-TMSI and RAI, and the TIN either indicates "P-TMSI" or is deleted. If the UE is configured for "AttachWithIMSI" as specified in 3GPP TS 24.368 [15A] or 3GPP TS 31.102 [17] and is attaching in a new PLMN that is neither the registered PLMN nor in the list of equivalent PLMNs, the UE shall not include this IE.

If the UE is configured for "AttachWithIMSI" as specified in 3GPP TS 24.368 [15A] or 3GPP TS 31.102 [17] and is attaching in a new PLMN that is neither the registered PLMN nor in the list of equivalent PLMNs, the UE shall not include this IE.

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.13 EMM information > 8.2.13.4 Local time zone]
This IE may be sent by the network. The UE should assume that this time zone applies to the tracking area of the current cell, and also applies to the tracking area list if available in the UE.

NOTE:	The time information can be inaccurate, especially when the TAI list includes tracking areas belonging to different time zones.

If the local time zone has been adjusted for daylight saving time, the network shall indicate this by including the Network daylight saving time IE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.13 EMM information > 8.2.13.4 Local time zone

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.13 EMM information > 8.2.13.5 Universal time and local time zone]
This IE may be sent by the network. The UE should assume that this time zone applies to the tracking area the UE is currently in, and also applies to the tracking area list if available in the UE. The UE shall not assume that the time information is accurate.

NOTE:	The time information can be inaccurate, especially when the TAI list includes tracking areas belonging to different time zones.

If the local time zone has been adjusted for daylight saving time, the network shall indicate this by including the Network daylight saving time IE.

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.2 T3412 value]
The MME shall include this IE during normal and combined tracking area updating procedure, and may include this IE during periodic tracking area updating procedure.

The MME shall include this IE if it includes the T3412 extended value IE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.2 T3412 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.2 "T3412 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.3 GUTI]
This IE may be included to assign a GUTI to a UE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.3 GUTI
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.3 "GUTI"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.4 TAI list]
This IE may be included to assign a TAI list to a UE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.4 TAI list
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.4 "TAI list"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.5 EPS bearer context status]
This IE shall be included if the network wants to indicate the EPS bearer contexts that are active for the UE in the network.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.5 EPS bearer context status
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.5 "EPS bearer context status"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.6 Location area identification]
This IE may be included to assign a new location area identification to a UE during a combined TA/LA update.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.6 Location area identification
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.6 "Location area identification"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.7 MS identity]
This IE may be included to assign or unassign a new TMSI to a UE during a combined TA/LA update.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.7 MS identity
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.7 "MS identity"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.8 EMM cause]
This IE shall be included if the combined tracking area updating procedure was successful for EPS services only.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.8 EMM cause
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.8 "EMM cause"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.9 T3402 value]
This IE may be included to indicate a value for timer T3402.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.9 T3402 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.9 "T3402 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.10 T3423 value]
This IE may be included to indicate a value for timer T3423.

If this IE is not included, the UE shall use the default value.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.10 T3423 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.10 "T3423 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.11 Equivalent PLMNs]
This IE may be included in order to assign a new equivalent PLMNs list to a UE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.11 Equivalent PLMNs
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.11 "Equivalent PLMNs"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.12 Emergency number list]
This IE may be sent by the network. If this IE is sent, the contents of this IE indicates a list of emergency numbers valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.12 Emergency number list
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.12 "Emergency number list"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.12A Extended emergency number list]
This IE may be sent by the network. If this IE is sent, the contents of this IE indicates a list of emergency numbers (with URN information) valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received or valid only in the PLMN from which this IE is received.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.12A Extended emergency number list
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.12A "Extended emergency number list"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.13 EPS network feature support]
The network may include this IE to inform the UE of the support of certain features. If this IE is not included then the UE shall interpret this as a receipt of an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero, except for the S1-u data transfer (S1-U data) (octet 4, bit 2).

NOTE: In this exceptional case, the UE deems that the network supports S1-u data transfer.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.13 EPS network feature support
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.13 "EPS network feature support"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.14 Additional update result]
The network may include this IE to provide the UE with additional information about the result of:

-	a combined tracking area updating procedure if the procedure was successful for EPS services and non-EPS services, or for EPS services and "SMS only"; or

-	a normal tracking area updating procedure requested for CIoT EPS optimizations if the procedure was successful for EPS services and "SMS only".
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.14 Additional update result
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.14 "Additional update result"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.15 T3412 extended value]
The network may include this IE to provide the UE with a longer periodic tracking area update timer.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.15 T3412 extended value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.15 "T3412 extended value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.16 T3324 value]
The network shall include the T3324 value IE if:

-	the UE included the T3324 value IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message; and

-	the network supports PSM and accepts the use of PSM.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.16 T3324 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.16 "T3324 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.17 Extended DRX parameters]
The network shall include the Extended DRX parameters IE if:

-	the UE included the Extended DRX parameters IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message; and

-	the network supports eDRX and accepts the use of eDRX.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.17 Extended DRX parameters
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.17 "Extended DRX parameters"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.18 DCN-ID]
This IE is included in the message when the network wishes to provide a DCN-ID to the UE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.18 DCN-ID
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.18 "DCN-ID"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.19 SMS services status]
This IE may be included when a normal tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" was successful for EPS services only.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.19 SMS services status
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.19 "SMS services status"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.20 Non-3GPP NW provided policies]
This IE is included if the network needs to indicate whether emergency numbers provided via non-3GPP access can be used to initiate UE detected emergency calls (see 3GPP TS 24.302 [48]). If this IE is not included then the UE shall interpret this as a receipt of an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.20 Non-3GPP NW provided policies
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.20 "Non-3GPP NW provided policies"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.21 T3448 value]
The network may include this IE if the congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane is active and the UE supports timer T3448.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.21 T3448 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.21 "T3448 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.22 Network policy]
This IE is included if the network needs to indicate network policy information to the UE. If this IE is not included, then the UE shall interpret this as a receipt of an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.22 Network policy
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.22 "Network policy"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.23 T3447 value]
The network may include T3447 value IE if:

-	the UE has indicated support for service gap control in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST messages; and

-	the EMM context contains a service gap time value.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.23 T3447 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.23 "T3447 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.24 Ciphering key data]
This IE is included if the network needs to send ciphering key data to the UE for ciphered broadcast assistance data.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.24 Ciphering key data
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.24 "Ciphering key data"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.25 UE radio capability ID]
This IE may be included in WB-S1 mode if both the UE and the network supports RACS and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.25 UE radio capability ID
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.25 "UE radio capability ID"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.26 UE radio capability ID deletion indication]
This IE may be included in WB-S1 mode if both the UE and the network supports RACS and the network needs to trigger the UE to delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN.
section_title: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.26 UE radio capability ID deletion indication
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.26 "UE radio capability ID deletion indication"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.27 Negotiated WUS assistance information]
The network shall include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE if:

-	the UE supports WUS assistance;

-	the MME supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance; and

-	the UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.27 Negotiated WUS assistance information
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.27 "Negotiated WUS assistance information"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.28 Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode]
The network shall include the Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE if the UE has included the DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
section_title: Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.28 Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.28 "Negotiated DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.29 Negotiated IMSI offset]
The network shall include the Negotiated IMSI offset IE if the network supports paging timing collision control and the MUSIM UE has included the Requested IMSI offset IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.29 Negotiated IMSI offset
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.29 "Negotiated IMSI offset"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.30 EPS additional request result]
The network may include this IE to inform the UE about the result of additional request.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.30 EPS additional request result
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.30 "EPS additional request result"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.31 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"]
This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.
section_title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.31 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.31 "Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming""

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.32 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"]
This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.
section_title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.26 Tracking area update accept > 8.2.26.32 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.26.32 "Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service""

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.27 Tracking area update complete]
This message shall be sent by the UE to the network in response to a tracking area update accept message if a GUTI has been changed or a new TMSI has been assigned. See table 8.2.27.1.

Message type:	TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE

Significance:	dual

Direction:	UE to network
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.27 Tracking area update complete
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.27 "Tracking area update complete"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.1 Message definition]
This message is sent by the network to the UE in order to reject the tracking area updating procedure. See table 8.2.28.1.

Message type:	TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT

Significance:	dual

Direction:	network to UE
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.1 Message definition
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.28.1 "Message definition"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.2 T3346 value]
The MME may include this IE when the general NAS level mobility management congestion control is active.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.2 T3346 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.28.2 "T3346 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.3 Extended EMM cause]
This IE may be included by the network to indicate additional information associated with the EMM cause.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.3 Extended EMM cause
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.28.3 "Extended EMM cause"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.4 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"]
This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.
section_title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.4 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.5 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"]
This IE is included to indicate the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service". This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.
section_title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.5 Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.28.5 "Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service""

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.6 Lower bound timer value]
The MME may include this IE when the EMM cause is set to #78 "PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location", to provide a minimum timer value for an entry added to the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location".
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.28 Tracking area update reject > 8.2.28.6 Lower bound timer value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.28.6 "Lower bound timer value"

[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.1 Message definition]
The purposes of sending the tracking area update request by the UE to the network are described in clause 5.5.3.1. See table 8.2.29.1.

Message type:	TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST

Significance:	dual

Direction:	UE to network

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.2 Non-current native NAS key set identifier]
The UE shall include this IE if the UE has a valid non-current native EPS security context when the UE performs an A/Gb mode or Iu mode or N1 mode to S1 mode inter-system change in EMM-CONNECTED mode and the UE uses a mapped EPS security context to protect the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
section_title: Non-current native NAS key set identifier
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.2 Non-current native NAS key set identifier
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.2 "Non-current native NAS key set identifier"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.3 GPRS ciphering key sequence number]
The UE shall include this IE if the UE performs an A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in EMM-IDLE mode and the TIN indicates "P-TMSI".
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.3 GPRS ciphering key sequence number
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.3 "GPRS ciphering key sequence number"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.4 Old P-TMSI signature]
The UE shall include this IE if the TIN indicates "P-TMSI" and the UE holds a valid P-TMSI signature, P-TMSI and RAI.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.4 Old P-TMSI signature
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.4 "Old P-TMSI signature"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.5 Additional GUTI]
The UE shall include this IE:

a)	if the TIN indicates "P-TMSI" and the UE holds a valid GUTI, P-TMSI and RAI; or

b)	if the UE performs an N1 mode to S1 mode inter-system change and the UE holds a valid GUTI.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.5 Additional GUTI
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.5 "Additional GUTI"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.6 NonceUE]
This IE is included if the UE performs an A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in idle mode and the TIN is set to "P-TMSI".
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.6 NonceUE
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.6 "NonceUE"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.7 UE network capability]
The UE shall include this IE, unless the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.7 UE network capability
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.7 "UE network capability"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.8 Last visited registered TAI]
This IE shall be included if the UE holds a valid last visited registered TAI.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.8 Last visited registered TAI
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.8 "Last visited registered TAI"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.9 DRX parameter]
This IE is included by the UE to indicate a change of UE specific DRX parameters to the network.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.9 DRX parameter
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.9 "DRX parameter"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.10 UE radio capability information update needed]
The UE shall include this IE if the UE radio capability information in the network needs to be updated.
section_title: UE radio capability information update needed
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.10 UE radio capability information update needed
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.10 "UE radio capability information update needed"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.11 EPS bearer context status]
This IE shall be included if the UE wants to indicate the EPS bearer contexts that are active within the UE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.11 EPS bearer context status
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.11 "EPS bearer context status"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.12 MS network capability]
A UE supporting A/Gb mode or Iu mode shall include this IE, unless the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.12 MS network capability
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.12 "MS network capability"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.13 Old location area identification]
The UE shall include this IE during a combined tracking area updating procedure if it has a valid location area identification.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.13 Old location area identification
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.13 "Old location area identification"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.14 TMSI status]
The UE shall include this IE during a combined tracking area updating procedure if it has no valid TMSI available.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.14 TMSI status
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.14 "TMSI status"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.15 Mobile station classmark 2]
This IE shall be included if the UE supports SRVCC to GERAN or UTRAN or supports vSRVCC to UTRAN (see 3GPP TS 23.216 [8]), or if the UE is performing a combined tracking area updating procedure.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.15 Mobile station classmark 2
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.15 "Mobile station classmark 2"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.16 Mobile station classmark 3]
This IE shall be included if the UE supports SRVCC to GERAN.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.16 Mobile station classmark 3
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.16 "Mobile station classmark 3"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.17 Supported Codecs]
This IE shall be included if the UE supports SRVCC to GERAN or UTRAN or supports vSRVCC to UTRAN to indicate its supported speech codecs for CS speech calls.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.17 Supported Codecs
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.17 "Supported Codecs"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.18 Additional update type]
The UE shall include this IE if the UE requests "SMS only" or CIoT EPS optimizations, unless the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.18 Additional update type
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.18 "Additional update type"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.19 Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting]
This IE shall be included in WB-S1 mode if and only if the UE supports:

-	CS fallback and SMS over SGs; or

-	if the UE is configured to support IMS voice, but does not support 1xCS fallback.
section_title: Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.19 Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.19 "Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.20 Old GUTI type]
The UE shall include this IE.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.20 Old GUTI type
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.20 "Old GUTI type"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.21 Device properties]
This IE shall be included if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.21 Device properties
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.21 "Device properties"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.22 MS network feature support]
This IE shall be included if the UE supports extended periodic timer T3412.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.22 MS network feature support
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.22 "MS network feature support"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.23 TMSI based NRI container]
The UE shall include this IE if it has a valid TMSI.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.23 TMSI based NRI container
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.23 "TMSI based NRI container"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.24 T3324 value]
The UE may include this IE to request the use of PSM.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.24 T3324 value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.24 "T3324 value"

text:
[8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.25 T3412 extended value]
The UE may include this IE to request a particular T3412 value if the T3324 value IE is included.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.25 T3412 extended value
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.25 "T3412 extended value"

text:

The UE shall include this IE if the UE supports dual connectivity with NR or if the UE supports N1 mode.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.27 UE additional security capability

This IE shall be included if the UE wants to provide the network with information concerning aspects of the current UE registration status which is used for interworking with 5GS.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.28 UE status

The UE shall include this IE if the UE supports ciphered broadcast assistance data and the UE needs to obtain new ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.29 Additional information requested
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.29 "Additional information requested"

The UE shall include this IE if the UE supports N1 mode and needs to indicate the supported CIoT network behaviour for 5GCN, unless the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure.

The UE may include this IE in WB-S1 mode if the UE supports RACS and the UE has an applicable UE radio capability ID for the current UE radio configuration in the selected PLMN.

This IE is included if the UE intends to use or change the UE specific DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode, except when the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure.
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.32 DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode

The UE may include this IE if it supports WUS assistance and it is not attaching for emergency bearer services.

The MUSIM UE may include this IE if the UE needs to indicate an IMSI offset value to the network as specified in 3GPP TS 23.401 [10] that is used for deriving the paging occasion as specified in 3GPP TS 36.304 [21].
heading_path: 8 Message functional definitions and contents > 8.2 EPS mobility management messages > 8.2.29 Tracking area update request > 8.2.29.34 Requested IMSI offset
citation: 3GPP TS 24.301 V17.12.0 (Release 17), clause 8.2.29.34 "Requested IMSI offset"

The UE shall include this IE if the MUSIM UE requests the release of the NAS signalling connection.

The UE shall include this IE if the Request type is set to "NAS signalling connection release" in the UE request type IE and the UE requests the network to restrict paging.
